name: Apple
tagline: Best-performing of the big tech names in 2026, now priced for it.
thesis: Ecosystem lock-in keeps customers upgrading inside Apple
Services keep growing as a share of profit
Trades about 1% below its Nov 13 record close
moat: Brand plus ecosystem switching costs. Very durable.
outlook: A great business, but the shares are up about 30% this year and sit near their high. The odds favour waiting for a pullback rather than chasing.
news: Only big-tech name still near a record (24/7 Wall St., Nov 18).
risks: Regulation of the App Store and Google search payments
changeMind: A 15–20% pullback without a business problem would make it a Buy
entryNote: More attractive after a meaningful pullback from the ~$356 record.

sources.title: 24/7 Wall St.: Apple is the only Magnificent Seven stock near a record

method: Quick screen, not a full analysis: moat, red flags, headline ratios and relative valuation.
